bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 6
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Delivery, CSN3108, we are still boarding two wheelchair passengers, request delay pushback for 10 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3108, Delivery, roger, standby, I'll call you back for pushback.

questions.question: Why does CSN3108 want to delay pushback?

options.C: Two wheelchair passengers are still boarding.
options.D: They are waiting for connecting baggage.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'we are still boarding two wheelchair passengers'，即两名轮椅旅客仍在登机，故请求推迟推出，选 C。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CXA8105, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point RWY36R via A, A5 and P.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Taxi to holding point RWY36R via A, A5 and P, CXA8105.

questions.question: Which taxiway will CXA8105 use last before reaching the holding point?
questions.explanation: 滑行指令为 'taxi to holding point RWY36R via A, A5 and P'，路线依次经 A、A5，最后一段为滑行道 P，故选 A；T2 对话中未提及。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CCA1507, a passenger has a severe asthma attack, we have administered oxygen, request priority landing and an ambulance.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1507, Wuhan Approach, roger PANPAN, you are number one, ambulance will be ready.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true?

options.A: The aircraft will divert to another airport.
options.C: The crew gave the passenger oxygen.

questions.explanation: 飞行员说 'we have administered oxygen'，即机组已为发病旅客供氧，故 C 正确；对话中没有提到备降、旅客拒绝救助或已康复。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW553, Wuhan Control, follow ZF-01A Arrival, descend to 1800m on QNH1007, Info M.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, ZF-01A Arrival, descend to 1900m on QNH1007, Info M, BAW553.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW553, negative, descend to 1800m on QNH1007.

questions.question: What did the controller correct in the readback?
questions.explanation: 管制员指令下 1800 米，飞行员误复诵为 '1900m'，管制员随即纠正 'negative, descend to 1800m'，被纠正的是高度，故选 D；QNH、进场程序和通波信息复诵均无误。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Approach, CES5856, TCAS RA, we are climbing.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES5856, roger, report clear of conflict.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wilco, CES5856.

questions.question: Why is CES5856 climbing?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'TCAS RA, we are climbing'，TCAS RA（决断咨询）是为避让冲突飞机，故选 A；这是机组自主避让动作，并非管制员指令。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN6420, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6420, cleared for takeoff, RWY36L, surface wind 020 degrees 6m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 120.6.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 120.6, CSN6420.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN6420, 800m climbing. We have a flap asymmetry warning, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6420, roger, turn right heading 330, descend to 900m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900m. Request a low pass over the runway so the tower can check the flaps visually, CSN6420.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6420, approved low pass RWY36L, report on final. After the low pass, contact Approach 127.35.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Low pass approved, will report on final, CSN6420.

questions.question: What was the wind condition when CSN6420 took off?
questions.explanation: 起飞指令中通报 'surface wind 020 degrees 6m/s'，风向 020 即东北风，风速 6 米/秒属轻风，故选 D；对话未提及静风、阵风或强侧风。

questions.question: What problem does CSN6420 have?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'We have a flap asymmetry warning'，即襟翼不对称警告，是襟翼故障，故选 A；与起落架、发动机失火、鸟击无关。

questions.question: What will CSN6420 probably do next?

options.C: Make a low pass for a visual check.

questions.explanation: 飞行员请求 'a low pass over the runway so the tower can check the flaps visually'，管制员也批准了 'low pass RWY36L'，故下一步是低空通场接受目视检查，选 C。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN5609, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 3nm left of track, expect rejoin the route at DA.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 3nm left of track, CSN5609.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CSN5609, weather radar shows a cell 25nm ahead of us, request deviate to the right for 12nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN5609, negative due to danger area, can you accept deviation to the left?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 030 for 15nm, CSN5609.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN5609, turn left heading 030, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Left heading 030, wilco, CSN5609.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CSN5609, our No.1 engine has flamed out, we are drifting down to 6600m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN5609, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching 6600m. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, aircraft drifting down between KG and TM, all aircraft below 7800m, leave the route to the east.

questions.question: How did the pilot of CSN5609 plan to avoid the weather?

options.B: Deviate to the right side for 12nm.
options.C: Deviate to the right side for 25nm.
options.D: Deviate to the left side for 25nm.

questions.explanation: 飞行员说 'request deviate to the right for 12nm'，即计划向右偏 12 海里绕飞（25nm 是天气距离，不是偏置距离），故选 B。

questions.question: Why was the right deviation not approved?
questions.explanation: 管制员回答 'negative due to danger area'，因右侧有危险区而不批准右偏，故选 B；未提及对头交通、军航活动或禁区。

questions.question: Which of the following statements about CSN5609 is NOT true?
questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 MAYDAY 并说 'our No.1 engine has flamed out, we are drifting down to 6600m'，A、C、D 均与原文一致；对话从未提及冰雹击伤，故选 B。

questions.question: Where is CSN5609 when it started drifting down?

options.B: Between KG and TM, drifting down to 6600m.

questions.explanation: 管制员广播 'aircraft drifting down between KG and TM'，结合飞行员报告的 'drifting down to 6600m'，可知飞机在 KG 与 TM 之间正下降到 6600 米，故选 B；7800m 是要求其他飞机避让的高度界限。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CES2331, 7nm final, established ILS, RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2331, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, reduce speed to 140kts, wind 330, 8m/s, gusting up to 18m/s, QNH1016.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue approach, speed 140kts, CES2331.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CES2331, going around! There is a vehicle crossing the runway!

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2331, roger, that was a runway inspection vehicle, it should have vacated by now. Climb to 900m, turn left heading 320.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Climb to 900m, heading 320, CES2331.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2331, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.4, the runway will be inspected again before your next approach.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 119.4, CES2331.

questions.question: Why did CES2331 go around?

options.A: The landing gear was not down.
options.C: The preceding aircraft was slow to vacate.
options.D: There was a vehicle on the runway.

questions.explanation: 飞行员喊 'going around! There is a vehicle crossing the runway!'，复飞原因是跑道上有车辆正在穿越，故选 D；与风大或前机未及时脱离无关。

questions.question: What was the vehicle doing on the runway?
questions.explanation: 管制员说 'that was a runway inspection vehicle'，即该车辆是跑道检查车，正在执行跑道检查，故选 A。

questions.question: What can be inferred from the exchange?

options.A: The vehicle driver will lose his job.
options.B: CES2331 will divert to another airport.
options.C: The vehicle was authorized to work near the runway.
options.D: The tower did not know the vehicle was there.

questions.explanation: 管制员明知该车是 'runway inspection vehicle'，且说 'the runway will be inspected again before your next approach'，可推断车辆是经授权在跑道附近作业的，故选 C；塔台并非不知情，也未提及备降或处罚司机。
